items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So Pee Wee Monte, who was Benny's private valet, you know, pulled Cootie over to the side

ctx.x: So Big Sid, with all the coaching of everyone in the band, we got him on the plane. So he gets even with the wings, where he can look out the window. We hadn't even taxied out to rev up. He saw this oil bubbling out from around the engine, he got up and went to the tail end of the plane. (laughs) So now, we get to Toronto. They're supposed to have reservations for the band. What's the name of the hotel in Toronto? King George? King Edward? James? Something.

Anyway, they didn't have accommodations for Big Sid, Cootie and myself. So Pee Wee Monte, who was Benny's private valet, you know, pulled Cootie over to the side and said, "Don't worry, we'll get you a room. Stay here." So Sid and I, we go out. Sid goes to the -- gets a cab and goes to the train station. Sees a red cap, calls him over. "Hey, brother," he says. "Where can I find a house of ill repute?" I said, "Sid, I don't want to see any women. All I want is a bed." "Well, brother, where you find a woman, you…
So this is his thing. This is what killed him. You know? Women killed him. Around the clock.
